scope: Twelve synthetic helper probes. Import bindings are removed; registration callbacks are inert. No model, CLI, schema pipeline, persistence, process runner, or application is exercised. PASS confirms the described observation, including limitations.

cases.description: A completed predecessor permits its pending dependent
A cancelled predecessor does not satisfy the dependent
The helper selects a child without rechecking the in-progress parent prerequisite
A done parent label satisfies a dependent despite an unfinished child
A cycle produces no eligible item, not a completion result
Nonzero exit without markers is an error
Completion marker is evaluated before a nonzero exit
A quoted marker in ordinary output is still matched
Completion wins when both complete and blocked markers occur
Actual registry categories; registration callbacks are inert stubs
Name predicate also admits an inherited Object property
Expansion candidate uses array length and can name an existing sparse ID
